app.name: OpenDoc Reader
app.startFailedBody: The app could not talk to its core. Close it and open it again. If this keeps happening, copy the diagnostics from Settings into a bug report.
fit.runsWellText: Fast enough for everyday use on this computer.
fit.slowText: Works, but expect long waits per page.
fit.wontFitText: Not enough memory. It can't be installed here.
queue.title: Queue
queue.label: File queue
drop.title: Drop PDFs or images here
drop.formats: PDF, PNG, JPG, TIFF (multi-page), BMP, WebP and HEIC. Folders work too.
drop.overlay: Drop files to add them to the queue
privacy.sentence: Everything runs on this computer. Nothing is uploaded.
action.convertNoModel: Install a model in Settings to convert files.
detail.waitingBody: It starts after the files above it are done.
detail.readyBody: Press Convert to start it with the options below.
detail.cancelledBody: The pages that were finished are kept.
detail.selectFile: Select a file in the queue.
notice.hasTextBody: Using the existing text is instant and exact. Running OCR reads the page images instead.
error.convert.failed: This file could not be converted.
error.badInput.file_not_found: The file could not be found. It may have been moved or deleted.
error.badInput.unreadable: The file could not be read. Check that no other program has it open.
error.badInput.corrupt: The file looks damaged and could not be opened.
error.badInput.password_protected: This PDF is password protected. Remove the password, then add it again.
error.badInput.unsupported_format: This type of file is not supported.
error.badInput.page_out_of_range: A page in this file could not be found.
error.outOfMemory: The computer ran out of memory while reading this file.
error.modelNotReady: The model could not be loaded.
error.recognitionFailed: The model could not read a page of this file.
error.engineUnavailable: The conversion engine is not running.
error.diskFull: There is not enough free space to save the result.
error.io: The result could not be written. Check the save location.
error.hint.retry: Try again. If it keeps failing, copy the diagnostics from Settings into a bug report.
error.hint.smallerModel: A smaller model needs less memory.
error.hint.reinstall: Reinstall the model in Settings, or try a smaller one.
error.hint.freeSpace: Free up space or choose another folder in Settings, then try again.
error.hint.badInput: Remove it from the queue and add a different copy.
error.addFailedUnsupported: None of those files can be converted. OpenDoc Reader reads PDF, PNG, JPG, TIFF, BMP, WebP and HEIC.
error.addFailed: The files could not be added.
error.pickerFailed: The file picker could not open.
error.exportFailed: The file could not be exported.
error.setting.invalid: That setting could not be changed right now.
setup.welcome.title: Welcome to OpenDoc Reader
setup.welcome.lede: Turn scanned documents and photos of documents into Word and Markdown files you can edit.
setup.welcome.next1: Check what this computer can run.
setup.welcome.next2: Choose a model and download it once.
setup.welcome.next3: Drop in your files and press Convert.
setup.computer.title: Your computer
setup.computer.lede: This is what OpenDoc Reader found.
setup.computer.failed: OpenDoc Reader could not check this computer.
setup.computer.noGpu: No supported graphics card found. The processor is used instead.
setup.computer.summaryAll: This computer can run every model.
setup.computer.summarySome: This computer can run the models, some of them slowly.
setup.computer.summaryLimited: Some models won't fit on this computer.
setup.models.title: Choose a model
setup.models.lede: You can install more than one. Models can be added or removed later in Settings.
setup.models.best.fast: Plain text and simple layouts. Tables and formulas are kept as images.
setup.models.best.experimental: Same job as Max. No quality advantage was measured. Needs about 7 GB of graphics memory.
setup.models.speedAbout: about {time} per page on this PC
setup.models.loadFailed: OpenDoc Reader could not work out which models fit this computer.
setup.download.title: Downloading
setup.download.lede: This happens once. After that, the app works offline.
setup.download.calibrating: Testing speed on a sample page...
setup.download.calibrated: About {time} per page on this computer.
setup.error.offline: OpenDoc Reader could not reach the internet. Check your connection, then try again. Files that were already downloaded are kept.
setup.error.downloadFailed: A file could not be downloaded. Try again. Files that were already downloaded are kept.
setup.error.checksumMismatch: A downloaded file did not match its checksum, so it was discarded. Try again to download it fresh.
setup.error.diskFull: There is not enough free space on {drive}. Free up space, or go back and choose another folder, then try again.
setup.error.diskFullNoDrive: There is not enough free space. Free up space, or go back and choose another folder, then try again.
setup.error.modelNotReady: A model could not be installed. Try again.
setup.error.default: The download could not finish. Try again.
setup.folderChangeFailed: The folder could not be changed because a model is already installed or downloading.
review.needsDone: Available when the file is done
review.loadFailed: This page could not be loaded.
review.noResult: This page has no result yet.
review.blockType.heading: Heading
review.blockType.caption: Caption
review.figureAlt: Figure cut out of the page
toast.usedText: Used the text already in the PDF.
settings.general.defaultFormatDesc: Used for new files. You can change it for each batch.
settings.general.defaultModelDesc: Used when you add files. The recommended model is used until you pick one.
settings.general.themeDesc: System follows the theme of your computer.
settings.general.updates: Check for new versions once a month
settings.general.updatesDesc: Only asks GitHub whether a newer version exists. Nothing about you is sent.
settings.general.vulkan: Use Vulkan for AMD and Intel graphics
settings.general.vulkanDesc: Experimental and untested. Applies to Windows computers with an AMD or Intel graphics card. Without it, those computers use the processor.
settings.models.name: Name
settings.models.folderLocked: The folder can only be changed while no model is installed.
settings.models.importDesc: For computers that can't download. Files are checked before use.
settings.models.advancedDesc: {size}, {license}. Needs about 7 GB of graphics memory. No quality advantage over Max was measured.
settings.models.removeBody: This frees {size} on {drive}. You can install it again later.
settings.models.removeBodyNoDrive: This frees {size}. You can install it again later.
settings.models.installFailed: The model could not be installed.
settings.models.removeFailed: The model could not be removed. It may be in use.
settings.models.importFailedChecksum: The files in that folder do not match the expected checksums.
settings.models.importFailed: The model could not be imported.
settings.privacy.title: OpenDoc Reader has no telemetry.
settings.privacy.body: Your documents and results stay on this computer. The app keeps a local log. If something goes wrong, you can copy it into a GitHub issue yourself.
settings.privacy.logsDesc: The log files stay on this computer.
settings.privacy.diagnosticsDesc: App version, system summary and recent log lines. Nothing is sent anywhere.
settings.privacy.copyFailed: The diagnostics could not be copied.
settings.about.licensesDesc: The app is released under the MIT License. Models keep their own licenses: Apache-2.0 (PaddleOCR-VL, PP-OCRv6) and MIT (DeepSeek-OCR).
